C1042.title: User Information Security Behavior and Data Breaches in BYOD Environments
C1042.summary: Research identifies user behavior as a major factor in data breaches. In BYOD settings, employees frequently fail to follow security policies when using personal mobile devices, leading to repeated data leakage incidents. The study cites data showing that user negligence and non-compliant behavior have become the weakest link in information security, directly enabling unauthorized access to person
